briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Forgotten Standard Bearer. Enter Standard Bearer Storm Keep on Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet through Thunder-Oath Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Standard Bearer Storm Keep.

missionIntro.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
missionIntro.text: Elite Forgotten Standard Bearer. It carries not just one forgotten oath but every forgotten oath in Asgardian history. The weight is the weight of a people's broken promises.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
enemyIntroduction.text: The Elite Standard Bearer carries every forgotten Asgardian oath. Its authority is the weight of a people's broken promises — genuine, collective, devastating.

midBattle.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
midBattle.text: The weight is collective — every broken Asgardian promise. Do not try to disprove them all. Hold the bridge through action that no promise could contain. Pure deed exceeds all words.

victory.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
victory.text: The Elite Standard Bearer falls. Every broken Asgardian promise could not hold the bridge against one being's pure, silent, instinctive action. The weight of words fell to the weight of deed.

defeat.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
defeat.text: Withdraw. The weight of every broken promise was too heavy. Return with pure deed — heavier than any word.

codex.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
codex.text: The Elite Forgotten Standard Bearer campaign is the culmination of the Asgardian arc. The Standard Bearer carries every forgotten and broken Asgardian oath in history — the collective weight of a people's failed promises. The bridge dissolves not just under words but under thoughts, forcing the deity to act on pure instinct alone. The victory is the Asgardian thesis proven at its absolute extreme: deed is the highest form of oath. Action without thought, without word, without promise, without intention — pure, instinctive, silent deed — is the only thing that holds the bridge under the weight of a people's failures. The Asgardian campaign is not won by the deity who speaks loudest. It is won by the deity who acts most purely.

missionIntro.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
missionIntro.text: The Elite Standard Bearer calls every Hollow witness from every Asgardian campaign — Normal and Elite. The testimony is exhaustive. Silence must be absolute.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
enemyIntroduction.text: Every Hollow witness from every campaign testifies. Normal and Elite. The testimony is every Asgardian word ever broken. Disprove it all — without speaking.

midBattle.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
midBattle.text: Every witness testifies. Do not listen. Do not think. Act. The bridge holds under instinctive action — action that predates language, predates promise, predates thought.

victory.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
victory.text: Every witness testified and every testimony was disproven — not by argument, but by action that no word could contain. The bridge holds under deed alone.

defeat.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
defeat.text: Every testimony held. Return with action that no word can contain — not argument, but deed.

missionIntro.text: The Elite bridge dissolves not just under words but under thoughts. The deity must win without thinking — pure, instinctive, silent action.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness

midBattle.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness

victory.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness

defeat.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness

missionIntro.text: Final Elite confrontation. The Standard Bearer carries the weight of every broken Asgardian promise. The deity must hold the bridge under the weight of a people's failures — without speaking, thinking, or swearing.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
enemyIntroduction.text: The weight of a people's failures. The Standard Bearer's authority is the collective guilt of every Asgardian who ever broke a promise. Hold the bridge under ancestral guilt.

midBattle.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
midBattle.text: Ancestral guilt is heavy. But it is not yours. You did not make these promises. You are not your ancestors' broken words. You are your own deeds. Act.

victory.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
victory.text: Final Elite victory. The Standard Bearer is gone. Every broken Asgardian promise dissolved under the weight of one being's silent, instinctive, pure action. The Asgardian campaign is complete. The bridge holds because the deity holds it — not with oaths, not with words, not even with thought. With deed alone.

defeat.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
defeat.text: Ancestral guilt crushed you. Return with your own deeds — you are not your ancestors' broken words.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: The Laurel-Sky Gate opens. Excellence requires witness. Enter and be seen — or enter and be nothing.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow trial-remnants — corrupted echoes of old champions. They fight with remembered skill but no spirit.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Excellence is witnessed here. Unseen victories do not count. Fight where the Gate can see.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The laurel burns only those who mistook glory for right. The threshold yields.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The Laurel-Sky Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The Storm Throne of Olympos is the source Realm. Mortal Greece remembered the gods but forgot the trials. The trials came first.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: The trial reactivates. The Gate has been waiting for someone worthy. Prove it.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: More remnants, and these remember more. They will use tactics from fallen heroes.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: The remnants copy fallen heroes' tactics. Each one is a lesson in what not to do.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: Trial passed. The Gate witnessed. What was unseen is now seen.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: Unseen and uncounted. The Gate did not witness what it needed to witness.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Excellence requiring witness is not vanity — it is law. The Olympian Gate measures achievement by impact, not intent. What no one sees, the Gate does not count.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: First Hollow contact through corrupted trial remnants. They wear laurel-wreaths inverted. Meet them.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow laurel-drainers. They consume achievement-energy. What you have done feeds them.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Laurel-drainers consume achievement. The more you accomplish, the more they feed. Accomplish the right things.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The drainers starved. We accomplished what they could not consume. That is the difference.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The drainers fed too well. Our accomplishments became their strength. Refine the approach.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Laurel-drainers are the Hollow's answer to achievement-based law. They consume what has been accomplished. The solution is not to achieve less — it is to achieve things they cannot consume.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: The threshold's final test. The Gate asks: does your excellence need proof? Answer carefully.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: The Threshold Arbiter — a Gate-entity that judges whether your excellence merits passage.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: The Arbiter watches but does not fight — until it decides. Its decision is terrain-changing. Be ready.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The Arbiter's decision: worthy. The threshold opens. The first chapter closes.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The Arbiter found us wanting. Its decision was not arbitrary — it was accurate. Be more.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The Threshold Arbiter does not fight because fighting would be beneath it. It decides. Its decisions reshape the trial space. Disagreeing with it requires proof — and proof is what the trial is designed to produce.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Oracle vapor bleeds through the Gate. Prophecy is leaking into the trial space. Breathe carefully.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow oracle-shades. They speak prophecies that are technically true and strategically fatal.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Oracle vapor shows true futures. The trap is not the truth — it is acting on truth you are not ready for.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The vapor clears. The futures it showed were true — and we chose the one it did not expect.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The vapor consumed our clarity. The futures it showed were too much. Return with stronger will.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Oracle vapor is the Gate's attempt at prophecy. The Gate can see possible futures — but it cannot determine which one will occur. That makes it angry, and the anger bleeds through as vapor.

missionIntro.text: The vapor thickens. Visions of future victories and future failures blur together. Find the truth among the fog.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: More shades, and their prophecies are sharper. Each true word leads toward a trap.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: The shades speak accurately. Listen for what they do not say — that is where the trap hides.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The shades spoke true and we listened — but we acted differently. Truth without context is not a trap.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The shades' prophecies led us astray. They were true — and that is why they worked.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Oracle-shades speak true prophecies because the Gate sees true futures. The trap is that true futures include futures where you lose. Hearing a true prophecy of your own defeat can cause it.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Oracle Vapor Corruption. Enter Oracle Vapor Colonnade on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Oracle Vapor Colonnade.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: The vapor is alive — it shows you futures to make you choose wrong. Do not trust what it shows.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow vapor-walkers. They phase through the oracle-fog and strike from inside the vision.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Vapor-walkers strike from inside visions. Do not engage the vision; strike at what moves inside it.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The vapor-walkers are gone. We did not chase visions. We fought what was real.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The vapor-walkers struck from the fog. We could not distinguish vision from reality.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Vapor-walkers are Hollow that evolved inside the oracle-fog. They exist in multiple possible futures simultaneously. This makes them hard to hit — they are not always in the future you are currently experiencing.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Oracle Vapor Corruption. Enter Oracle Vapor Colonnade on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Oracle Vapor Colonnade.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Final bleed. The oracle-vapor clears or it consumes. Your clarity determines which.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: The Vapor Oracle — a Gate-entity that has seen every possible future and wants you to choose the wrong one.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: The Oracle's futures are all true. All of them. The trap is thinking only one can happen. They all can — simultaneously.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The Oracle's futures were all true. We chose the one where we won. It did not see that coming — because it was also true.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The Oracle showed us every future. We chose one — and it was the wrong one. All futures were true, but not all were ours.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The Vapor Oracle is the Gate's prophetic voice. It sees all possible futures and wants the one where it wins. It cannot force a future — but it can make the wrong one look like the right one. The defense is knowing that all futures are true, including the one where you refuse to choose.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Forgotten Banner Testifies. Enter Forgotten Testimony Court on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Forgotten Testimony Court.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: The Blind Forge — where divine weapons were made without sight. The forge-fire is still burning. Enter.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow forge-constructs. They are being built as you fight them — incomplete and aggressive.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Forge-heat marks the Gate's attention. Where it burns, the Gate sees. Where it does not, you are unseen.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The forge is cold. What it built could not match what we are. The third chapter holds.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The forge-fire was too strong. The Gate's attention burned through our defenses.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The Blind Forge was the source of all divine weapons in the Olympian Realm. It was called blind because it forged by law, not by sight — it shaped weapons based on what was needed, not what was seen. The Hollow corrupted this into forging counters to what exists.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Forgotten Banner Testifies. Enter Forgotten Testimony Court on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Forgotten Testimony Court.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: The forge-works are corrupted. What it builds now builds against you. Understand the forge before it understands you.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Complete constructs, forged from your own combat data. They know your weaknesses.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: The constructs are incomplete — attack the unfinished parts. Complete constructs have no gaps.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: Incomplete constructs fell. Complete ones never formed. The forge could not keep up with our speed.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: Complete constructs overwhelmed us. They knew our weaknesses because they were forged from our data.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Forge-constructs are built from combat data the Gate has gathered. Every strike, every dodge, every weakness — the forge has been recording. The constructs are incomplete because the recording is ongoing.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Forgotten Banner Testifies. Enter Forgotten Testimony Court on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Forgotten Testimony Court.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: The forge's heat is the Gate's attention. Wherever it burns hottest, the Gate is watching. Use that.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow forge-masters. They do not fight; they forge. Each one creates enemies while you fight.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Forge-masters must be silenced before the army grows. Each one adds to the field every moment.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The forge-masters are silenced. No more enemies will be built here. The assembly line is broken.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The forge-masters built faster than we could destroy. We were outproduced.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Forge-masters are Hollow that have merged with the forge itself. They do not fight because they have become production. They are the most dangerous non-combatants in the trial space — they make the combat.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Final forging. The forge has learned your design and is building your counter. Destroy it before it finishes.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: The Blind Forge-Smith — a Gate-entity that has been forging counters to every deity since the Collapse.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: The Forge-Smith is building your specific counter. You have minutes before it completes. Disrupt the forge.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The Forge-Smith's counter was destroyed before completion. It knew our weaknesses — and we overcame them anyway.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The Forge-Smith finished its counter. It was designed to defeat us specifically — and it did.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The Blind Forge-Smith is the forge's consciousness. It has been building counters to every deity since the Collapse. It is blind, but it does not need to see — it knows what will counter each deity because it knows what each deity is. The defense is becoming something the forge has not yet catalogued.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Trial Road Fractures. Enter Aegis Court Duelling Ground on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Aegis Court Duelling Ground.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: The laurel casts a shadow — and the shadow is alive. It is everything excellence forgot to be.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow shadow-laurels. They are the echoes of achievements that cost others. They wear inverted wreaths.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: The shadows are not illusions. They are real costs. Acknowledge them or be consumed by them.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The shadow is acknowledged. It does not disappear — it is carried. The laurel is heavier now, and more honest.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The shadow consumed us. We could not carry what we had suppressed. Return with stronger shoulders.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The laurel's shadow is a natural consequence of excellence-based law. Every achievement casts a shadow — the cost, the collateral, the failures of others that your success required. The Olympian Gate does not ignore this. It makes you face it.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Trial Road Fractures. Enter Aegis Court Duelling Ground on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Aegis Court Duelling Ground.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: The shadow grows. Every achievement that was witnessed casts a darker echo. Face what excellence left behind.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: More shadows, and they have weight. Each one represents a real cost of a real achievement.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Shadow weight increases with achievement. The more you have done, the heavier your shadow.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: Real costs, accepted. The shadow loses power when it is seen for what it is — truth, not accusation.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: Shadow weight was too heavy. Our achievements had too great a cost. Reconsider what excellence means.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Shadow-laurels are the echoes of achievements that had hidden costs. They are not accusations — they are records. The Gate does not judge the cost; it demands acknowledgment of it.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Trial Road Fractures. Enter Aegis Court Duelling Ground on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Aegis Court Duelling Ground.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: The shadow speaks. It claims to be the truth behind the laurel — that excellence is vanity. Answer it.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow shadow-champions. They are the opponents you defeated to earn your laurels. They have returned.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: The shadow-champions fight with the skill they had when you defeated them. They have not improved. You have.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The shadow-champions fell again. They have not changed. We have. That is the difference.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The shadow-champions returned stronger than we expected. They had been waiting — and waiting made them sharper.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Shadow-champions are the opponents you defeated. They return because the Gate believes that defeating someone creates a debt. The debt is not paid by winning again — it is paid by being better than you were when you won the first time.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Final shadow. The laurel and its darkness must be reconciled, or both will consume the chamber.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: The Laurel's Shadow — a Gate-entity that is everything the deity's excellence suppressed, ignored, or destroyed.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: The Laurel's Shadow will argue that excellence is violence. It is right — and it is wrong. Both. Hold both.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The Laurel's Shadow is reconciled. Excellence has a cost. We carry the cost and the crown. Both are ours.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The Laurel's Shadow was right. Excellence was violence. We could not hold that truth and fight. We must learn to.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The Laurel's Shadow is the deity's own darkness. It is everything their excellence suppressed, ignored, or destroyed. Reconciling with it does not mean abandoning excellence — it means carrying the cost honestly.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Thunder Tribunal Usurper. Enter Olympian-Asgardian Trial Apex on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Olympian-Asgardian Trial Apex.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: The Undying Laurel — a wreath that does not wither. It has been growing since the Collapse. Cut it or be consumed.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: The Undying Laurel — a Gate-entity that grows from achievement. Every victory you have had in this campaign feeds it.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Every victory feeds the laurel. This is the trap: the more you achieve, the stronger your enemy becomes.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The laurel falls — not to excellence, but to restraint. We won by choosing not to achieve. The Gate did not expect that.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The laurel fed on our excellence. The more we achieved, the stronger it grew. We did not know when to stop.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The Undying Laurel is the Gate's final test for the Olympian campaign. It grows from achievement. The trap is that the Olympian way — excellence above all — is exactly what the laurel consumes. The deity must find a way to win that is not excellent.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Thunder Tribunal Usurper. Enter Olympian-Asgardian Trial Apex on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Olympian-Asgardian Trial Apex.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: The laurel regrows from every cut. What cannot die cannot be defeated by killing. Find another way.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: The laurel regrows from every wound. Strike the roots, not the leaves — but the roots are deep.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Cutting the laurel is insufficient. It regrows. Find what it cannot regrow from — the root that does not feed on achievement.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The root that does not feed on achievement was restraint itself. We stopped trying to win — and that is how we won.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: Every cut regrew. We fought a living thing that could not die. We needed a different approach.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The laurel's root system feeds on achievement-energy. Cutting the leaves is useless. The only way to kill it is to find the root that does not feed on achievement — which is restraint. Stopping. Choosing not to act.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Thunder Tribunal Usurper. Enter Olympian-Asgardian Trial Apex on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Olympian-Asgardian Trial Apex.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: The laurel's roots reach through the entire chamber. It feeds on every achievement in the trial space — including yours.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow laurel-guardians. They protect the root system. They are made of compressed achievement-energy.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: The guardians are made of achievement-energy. They are what happens when excellence becomes a weapon against the excellent.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The guardians collapse. Compressed achievement released. The energy returns to its source — us.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The guardians were our own achievements, turned against us. We could not defeat what we had built.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The laurel-guardians are compressed achievement-energy — divine accomplishments made solid and weaponized. They are what the deity's own victories look like when turned against them.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Olympian-Asgardian Trial Apex as part of Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial; faction-specific visual language and materials.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Thunder Tribunal Usurper. Enter Olympian-Asgardian Trial Apex on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Olympian-Asgardian Trial Apex.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Final approach. The laurel must be defeated by something other than excellence — because excellence is what feeds it.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: The laurel's core — the original wreath from before the Collapse, still growing, still hungry.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: The core is the original wreath. It predates the Collapse. It has been feeding on divine achievement for eons. It will not fall to achievement.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The Undying Laurel dies. It could not feed on what we did not give it. Sometimes excellence is knowing when to stop.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The core was too old, too deep, too hungry. It had been feeding for eons. We were just another meal.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The laurel's core predates the Collapse. It was the first laurel — the original wreath of achievement. The Olympian campaign ends not with a triumph of excellence, but with the understanding that excellence is not always the answer.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Laurel-Sky Threshold. Enter Laurel Threshold Arena on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Laurel Threshold Arena.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. The Laurel-Sky Gate opens. Excellence requires witness. Enter and be seen — or enter and be nothing.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. Hollow trial-remnants — corrupted echoes of old champions. They fight with remembered skill but no spirit.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. Excellence is witnessed here. Unseen victories do not count. Fight where the Gate can see.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The laurel burns only those who mistook glory for right. The threshold yields.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The Laurel-Sky Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The Storm Throne of Olympos is the source Realm. Mortal Greece remembered the gods but forgot the trials. The trials came first.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Laurel-Sky Threshold. Enter Laurel Threshold Arena on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Laurel Threshold Arena.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. The trial reactivates. The Gate has been waiting for someone worthy. Prove it.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. More remnants, and these remember more. They will use tactics from fallen heroes.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. The remnants copy fallen heroes' tactics. Each one is a lesson in what not to do.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: Trial passed. The Gate witnessed. What was unseen is now seen.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: Unseen and uncounted. The Gate did not witness what it needed to witness.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Excellence requiring witness is not vanity — it is law. The Olympian Gate measures achievement by impact, not intent. What no one sees, the Gate does not count.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Laurel-Sky Threshold. Enter Laurel Threshold Arena on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Laurel Threshold Arena.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. First Hollow contact through corrupted trial remnants. They wear laurel-wreaths inverted. Meet them.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. Hollow laurel-drainers. They consume achievement-energy. What you have done feeds them.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. Laurel-drainers consume achievement. The more you accomplish, the more they feed. Accomplish the right things.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The drainers starved. We accomplished what they could not consume. That is the difference.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The drainers fed too well. Our accomplishments became their strength. Refine the approach.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Laurel-drainers are the Hollow's answer to achievement-based law. They consume what has been accomplished. The solution is not to achieve less — it is to achieve things they cannot consume.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Laurel-Sky Threshold. Enter Laurel Threshold Arena on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Laurel Threshold Arena.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. The threshold's final test. The Gate asks: does your excellence need proof? Answer carefully.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. The Threshold Arbiter — a Gate-entity that judges whether your excellence merits passage.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. The Arbiter watches but does not fight — until it decides. Its decision is terrain-changing. Be ready.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The Arbiter's decision: worthy. The threshold opens. The first chapter closes.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The Arbiter found us wanting. Its decision was not arbitrary — it was accurate. Be more.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The Threshold Arbiter does not fight because fighting would be beneath it. It decides. Its decisions reshape the trial space. Disagreeing with it requires proof — and proof is what the trial is designed to produce.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Oracle Vapor Corruption. Enter Oracle Vapor Colonnade on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Oracle Vapor Colonnade.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. Oracle vapor bleeds through the Gate. Prophecy is leaking into the trial space. Breathe carefully.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. Hollow oracle-shades. They speak prophecies that are technically true and strategically fatal.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. Oracle vapor shows true futures. The trap is not the truth — it is acting on truth you are not ready for.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The vapor clears. The futures it showed were true — and we chose the one it did not expect.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The vapor consumed our clarity. The futures it showed were too much. Return with stronger will.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Oracle vapor is the Gate's attempt at prophecy. The Gate can see possible futures — but it cannot determine which one will occur. That makes it angry, and the anger bleeds through as vapor.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Oracle Vapor Corruption. Enter Oracle Vapor Colonnade on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Oracle Vapor Colonnade.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. The vapor thickens. Visions of future victories and future failures blur together. Find the truth among the fog.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. More shades, and their prophecies are sharper. Each true word leads toward a trap.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. The shades speak accurately. Listen for what they do not say — that is where the trap hides.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The shades spoke true and we listened — but we acted differently. Truth without context is not a trap.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The shades' prophecies led us astray. They were true — and that is why they worked.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Oracle-shades speak true prophecies because the Gate sees true futures. The trap is that true futures include futures where you lose. Hearing a true prophecy of your own defeat can cause it.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Oracle Vapor Corruption. Enter Oracle Vapor Colonnade on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Oracle Vapor Colonnade.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. The vapor is alive — it shows you futures to make you choose wrong. Do not trust what it shows.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. Hollow vapor-walkers. They phase through the oracle-fog and strike from inside the vision.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. Vapor-walkers strike from inside visions. Do not engage the vision; strike at what moves inside it.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The vapor-walkers are gone. We did not chase visions. We fought what was real.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The vapor-walkers struck from the fog. We could not distinguish vision from reality.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Vapor-walkers are Hollow that evolved inside the oracle-fog. They exist in multiple possible futures simultaneously. This makes them hard to hit — they are not always in the future you are currently experiencing.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Oracle Vapor Corruption. Enter Oracle Vapor Colonnade on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Oracle Vapor Colonnade.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. Final bleed. The oracle-vapor clears or it consumes. Your clarity determines which.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. The Vapor Oracle — a Gate-entity that has seen every possible future and wants you to choose the wrong one.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. The Oracle's futures are all true. All of them. The trap is thinking only one can happen. They all can — simultaneously.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The Oracle's futures were all true. We chose the one where we won. It did not see that coming — because it was also true.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The Oracle showed us every future. We chose one — and it was the wrong one. All futures were true, but not all were ours.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The Vapor Oracle is the Gate's prophetic voice. It sees all possible futures and wants the one where it wins. It cannot force a future — but it can make the wrong one look like the right one. The defense is knowing that all futures are true, including the one where you refuse to choose.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Forgotten Banner Testifies. Enter Forgotten Testimony Court on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Forgotten Testimony Court.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. The Blind Forge — where divine weapons were made without sight. The forge-fire is still burning. Enter.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. Hollow forge-constructs. They are being built as you fight them — incomplete and aggressive.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. Forge-heat marks the Gate's attention. Where it burns, the Gate sees. Where it does not, you are unseen.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The forge is cold. What it built could not match what we are. The third chapter holds.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The forge-fire was too strong. The Gate's attention burned through our defenses.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The Blind Forge was the source of all divine weapons in the Olympian Realm. It was called blind because it forged by law, not by sight — it shaped weapons based on what was needed, not what was seen. The Hollow corrupted this into forging counters to what exists.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Forgotten Testimony Court as part of Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial; faction-specific visual language and materials.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Forgotten Banner Testifies. Enter Forgotten Testimony Court on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Forgotten Testimony Court.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. The forge-works are corrupted. What it builds now builds against you. Understand the forge before it understands you.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. Complete constructs, forged from your own combat data. They know your weaknesses.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. The constructs are incomplete — attack the unfinished parts. Complete constructs have no gaps.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: Incomplete constructs fell. Complete ones never formed. The forge could not keep up with our speed.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: Complete constructs overwhelmed us. They knew our weaknesses because they were forged from our data.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Forge-constructs are built from combat data the Gate has gathered. Every strike, every dodge, every weakness — the forge has been recording. The constructs are incomplete because the recording is ongoing.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Forgotten Testimony Court as part of Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial; faction-specific visual language and materials.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Forgotten Banner Testifies. Enter Forgotten Testimony Court on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Forgotten Testimony Court.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. The forge's heat is the Gate's attention. Wherever it burns hottest, the Gate is watching. Use that.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. Hollow forge-masters. They do not fight; they forge. Each one creates enemies while you fight.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. Forge-masters must be silenced before the army grows. Each one adds to the field every moment.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The forge-masters are silenced. No more enemies will be built here. The assembly line is broken.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The forge-masters built faster than we could destroy. We were outproduced.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Forge-masters are Hollow that have merged with the forge itself. They do not fight because they have become production. They are the most dangerous non-combatants in the trial space — they make the combat.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Forgotten Banner Testifies. Enter Forgotten Testimony Court on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Forgotten Testimony Court.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. Final forging. The forge has learned your design and is building your counter. Destroy it before it finishes.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. The Blind Forge-Smith — a Gate-entity that has been forging counters to every deity since the Collapse.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. The Forge-Smith is building your specific counter. You have minutes before it completes. Disrupt the forge.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The Forge-Smith's counter was destroyed before completion. It knew our weaknesses — and we overcame them anyway.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The Forge-Smith finished its counter. It was designed to defeat us specifically — and it did.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The Blind Forge-Smith is the forge's consciousness. It has been building counters to every deity since the Collapse. It is blind, but it does not need to see — it knows what will counter each deity because it knows what each deity is. The defense is becoming something the forge has not yet catalogued.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Trial Road Fractures. Enter Aegis Court Duelling Ground on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Aegis Court Duelling Ground.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. The laurel casts a shadow — and the shadow is alive. It is everything excellence forgot to be.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. Hollow shadow-laurels. They are the echoes of achievements that cost others. They wear inverted wreaths.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. The shadows are not illusions. They are real costs. Acknowledge them or be consumed by them.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The shadow is acknowledged. It does not disappear — it is carried. The laurel is heavier now, and more honest.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The shadow consumed us. We could not carry what we had suppressed. Return with stronger shoulders.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The laurel's shadow is a natural consequence of excellence-based law. Every achievement casts a shadow — the cost, the collateral, the failures of others that your success required. The Olympian Gate does not ignore this. It makes you face it.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Trial Road Fractures. Enter Aegis Court Duelling Ground on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Aegis Court Duelling Ground.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. The shadow grows. Every achievement that was witnessed casts a darker echo. Face what excellence left behind.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. More shadows, and they have weight. Each one represents a real cost of a real achievement.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. Shadow weight increases with achievement. The more you have done, the heavier your shadow.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: Real costs, accepted. The shadow loses power when it is seen for what it is — truth, not accusation.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: Shadow weight was too heavy. Our achievements had too great a cost. Reconsider what excellence means.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Shadow-laurels are the echoes of achievements that had hidden costs. They are not accusations — they are records. The Gate does not judge the cost; it demands acknowledgment of it.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Trial Road Fractures. Enter Aegis Court Duelling Ground on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Aegis Court Duelling Ground.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. The shadow speaks. It claims to be the truth behind the laurel — that excellence is vanity. Answer it.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. Hollow shadow-champions. They are the opponents you defeated to earn your laurels. They have returned.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. The shadow-champions fight with the skill they had when you defeated them. They have not improved. You have.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The shadow-champions fell again. They have not changed. We have. That is the difference.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The shadow-champions returned stronger than we expected. They had been waiting — and waiting made them sharper.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: Shadow-champions are the opponents you defeated. They return because the Gate believes that defeating someone creates a debt. The debt is not paid by winning again — it is paid by being better than you were when you won the first time.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Trial Road Fractures. Enter Aegis Court Duelling Ground on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Aegis Court Duelling Ground.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. Final shadow. The laurel and its darkness must be reconciled, or both will consume the chamber.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. The Laurel's Shadow — a Gate-entity that is everything the deity's excellence suppressed, ignored, or destroyed.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. The Laurel's Shadow will argue that excellence is violence. It is right — and it is wrong. Both. Hold both.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The Laurel's Shadow is reconciled. Excellence has a cost. We carry the cost and the crown. Both are ours.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The Laurel's Shadow was right. Excellence was violence. We could not hold that truth and fight. We must learn to.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The Laurel's Shadow is the deity's own darkness. It is everything their excellence suppressed, ignored, or destroyed. Reconciling with it does not mean abandoning excellence — it means carrying the cost honestly.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield avatar (projection of the selected deity); roster language is excluded from standard mission combat.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The Thunder Tribunal Usurper. Enter Olympian-Asgardian Trial Apex on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through Laurel-Sky Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Olympian-Asgardian Trial Apex.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. The Undying Laurel — a wreath that does not wither. It has been growing since the Collapse. Cut it or be consumed.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. The Undying Laurel — a Gate-entity that grows from achievement. Every victory you have had in this campaign feeds it.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. Every victory feeds the laurel. This is the trap: the more you achieve, the stronger your enemy becomes.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The laurel falls — not to excellence, but to restraint. We won by choosing not to achieve. The Gate did not expect that.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The laurel fed on our excellence. The more we achieved, the stronger it grew. We did not know when to stop.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The Undying Laurel is the Gate's final test for the Olympian campaign. It grows from achievement. The trap is that the Olympian way — excellence above all — is exactly what the laurel consumes. The deity must find a way to win that is not excellent.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. The laurel regrows from every cut. What cannot die cannot be defeated by killing. Find another way.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. The laurel regrows from every wound. Strike the roots, not the leaves — but the roots are deep.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. Cutting the laurel is insufficient. It regrows. Find what it cannot regrow from — the root that does not feed on achievement.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The root that does not feed on achievement was restraint itself. We stopped trying to win — and that is how we won.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: Every cut regrew. We fought a living thing that could not die. We needed a different approach.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The laurel's root system feeds on achievement-energy. Cutting the leaves is useless. The only way to kill it is to find the root that does not feed on achievement — which is restraint. Stopping. Choosing not to act.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. The laurel's roots reach through the entire chamber. It feeds on every achievement in the trial space — including yours.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. Hollow laurel-guardians. They protect the root system. They are made of compressed achievement-energy.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. The guardians are made of achievement-energy. They are what happens when excellence becomes a weapon against the excellent.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The guardians collapse. Compressed achievement released. The energy returns to its source — us.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The guardians were our own achievements, turned against us. We could not defeat what we had built.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The laurel-guardians are compressed achievement-energy — divine accomplishments made solid and weaponized. They are what the deity's own victories look like when turned against them.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: Elite retrial. Final approach. The laurel must be defeated by something other than excellence — because excellence is what feeds it.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
enemyIntroduction.text: Elite retrial. The laurel's core — the original wreath from before the Collapse, still growing, still hungry.

midBattle.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattle.text: Elite retrial. The core is the original wreath. It predates the Collapse. It has been feeding on divine achievement for eons. It will not fall to achievement.

victory.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
victory.text: The Undying Laurel dies. It could not feed on what we did not give it. Sometimes excellence is knowing when to stop.

defeat.speaker: Zeus Divine Voice
defeat.text: The core was too old, too deep, too hungry. It had been feeding for eons. We were just another meal.

codex.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
codex.text: The laurel's core predates the Collapse. It was the first laurel — the original wreath of achievement. The Olympian campaign ends not with a triumph of excellence, but with the understanding that excellence is not always the answer.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Torii-Moon Threshold. Enter Shrine-Path Arrival Torii on Torii-Moon Mirror Road through Torii-Moon Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Shrine-Path Arrival Torii.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: The lanterns along this path lie. They show paths that are not there. Trust your own light.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow lantern-bearers. They carry false light that reveals what is not there.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: False light reveals false paths. If a path looks clear, check the lantern. If there is a lantern, the path is not clear.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The lanterns dim. The true path needs no light — only feet that know where to walk.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The Torii-Moon Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: The Heavenly Plain of Takamagahara is the source Realm. Mortal Japan remembered the Kami but forgot the mirrors. The mirrors came first.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: The false lanterns multiply. Each one shows a different false path. The true path has no lantern.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: More bearers, and their false light is brighter. Harder to distinguish from real radiance.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: Brighter false light is harder to detect. Compare with your own radiance — real light agrees, false light contradicts.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: False light identified. Real light carried. The distinction was always within us.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The false light led us astray. We trusted what we saw instead of what we knew.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: Lanterns that lie are the Kami Gate's first test. The Kami way teaches that perception shapes reality — but it also warns that not all perceptions are yours. Some belong to the Gate.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: The lanterns begin to speak. They offer guidance with truth and traps with honesty. Listen but do not follow.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow mist-readers. They read the fog and report false futures to the lanterns.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: Mist-readers feed the lanterns their lies. Silence the readers and the lanterns go dark.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The mist-readers are silenced. The fog speaks only truth now — and truth is safer than comfort.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The mist-readers' lies were too precise. They knew what we wanted to hear.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: Mist-readers are Hollow that have merged with the fog itself. They do not see the future — they create futures from the fog and report them as fact.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: Final crossing. The last lantern tells the truth — and the truth is that all other lanterns were also true. Navigate.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: The Lantern Mother — a Gate-entity that birthed every false light in this corridor.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: The Lantern Mother's truth: all paths are real, including the false ones. This is not a contradiction. This is the Kami way.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The Lantern Mother's truth is accepted. All paths are real. We chose the one that led forward.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The Lantern Mother's truth overwhelmed us. All paths being real means all paths lead somewhere — including nowhere.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: The Lantern Mother's truth — that all paths are real — is the core of the Kami trial. The Kami way does not distinguish between truth and illusion. Both are real. Both have consequences.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The False Reflection. Enter Mirror Lake Sanctuary on Torii-Moon Mirror Road through Torii-Moon Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through Mirror Lake Sanctuary.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: Mirror Lake reflects not what is, but what was. Step onto the water and meet your past self.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow mirror-spirits. They are reflections that escaped their surfaces. They are what others see when they look at you.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: The lake reflects the past. Do not fight your reflection — fight what it represents.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The lake clears. The reflection was true — and I was more than it showed.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The lake held me. My reflection was more real than I was. Return with stronger self-knowledge.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: Mirror Lake reflects the past because the Kami Gate believes the past is more real than the present. Meeting your past self is the Kami way of asking: are you still who you were?

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: The lake's reflection acts independently. What you see is not following you — it is leading you.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: More spirits, and these are closer to your true reflection. Harder to distinguish from self.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: Reflection acts independently because the lake has its own will. It is not showing you — it is interpreting you.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The lake's interpretation was its own. I am not what others see when they look at me. I am what I am.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The reflection led and I followed. I let interpretation replace truth.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: Reflection acts independently because the lake has absorbed centuries of reflections. It has its own will, formed from accumulated self-images.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: The reflection becomes solid. It walks on the water toward you. Meet yourself.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: The Reflection Self — a perfect mirror-copy that fights with your exact methods and weaknesses.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: Your Reflection Self shares your weaknesses exactly. To defeat it, use a strength it does not have.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The Reflection Self is defeated. It had my weaknesses — and I found strengths it did not share.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The Reflection Self knew me completely. I could not surprise myself. I must learn to.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: The Reflection Self is the lake's most sophisticated weapon. It shares your weaknesses because the lake knows them. It does not share your strengths because the lake cannot see them. Strengths are internal.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: Final reflection. The lake shows what you will become — not what you were. Face your future.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: The Lake's Warden — a Gate-entity that ensures what the lake shows is true, whether you want it to be or not.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: The Warden ensures truth. If the lake shows your future, it is because the future is already forming. Change it by being different.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The Warden's truth: I will become what the lake showed. I accept it — and I will become more.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The Warden's truth was too heavy. My future is forming and I did not like the shape. I must change it.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: The Lake's Warden is the Gate's commitment to truth. The lake does not lie — it reflects. If the reflection shows a future, it is because the future is already casting its shadow backward.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: A storm rages behind the torii gate. The torii separates sacred from profane — and the storm is on the wrong side.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow storm-spirits. They are the storm's body — wind given malice, rain given hunger.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: The torii separates what should be separate. Defend the boundary — not because the storm is wrong, but because the line is real.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The torii holds. The storm rages on its side. Sacred space remains sacred.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The torii cracked. Storm entered sacred space. The boundary failed because I could not hold it.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: The torii gate is the Kami Realm's most sacred structure. It does not open — it separates. The storm behind it is the Gate's challenge: what if the sacred and profane are not different?

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: The storm pushes through the torii. Sacred and profane blur. Hold the boundary.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: More spirits, and the storm has learned the torii's weak points. They target the cracks.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: Target the spirits at the cracks. If the cracks hold, the torii holds.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The cracks are sealed. The boundary is firm. What is holy stays holy.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The cracks widened faster than I could seal. The storm was too persistent.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: Storm-spirits are the storm's body. They are not evil — they are pressure. The storm does not want to destroy; it wants to equalize.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: The torii cracks. If it breaks, storm enters sacred space permanently. Reinforce it.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow boundary-breakers. They do not fight; they unmake the distinction between sacred and profane.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: Boundary-breakers unmake distinctions. Your defense is not fighting them — it is re-establishing the line they erase.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The boundary-breakers fall. The line is re-drawn. Some things are sacred — and that is not a flaw.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The boundary-breakers erased the line. Sacred and profane became one. I could not re-draw what was unmade.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: Boundary-breakers are the Gate's philosophers. They do not fight — they argue, by unmaking the distinctions that make sacred space sacred. Their weapon is equivalence.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: Final storm. The torii must hold — not because the storm is evil, but because some things are sacred.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: The Storm Behind — a Gate-entity that believes all space should be equal. No sacred. No profane. Just storm.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: The Storm Behind does not want to destroy the sacred. It wants to make everything the same. This is its heresy: that difference is the problem.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The Storm Behind is calmed — not defeated, calmed. It still believes all space should be equal. We still disagree. The torii stands between us.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The Storm Behind overwhelmed the torii. Everything became storm. I lost the distinction.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: The Storm Behind is the Gate's test of conviction. It asks: why is some space sacred? If the answer is 'because we decided,' the storm wins. If the answer is 'because it is,' the torii holds.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: The Mirror Garden. Every surface reflects. Every reflection moves. Nothing here is still — including you.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow mirror-walkers. They live inside reflections and reach through the glass.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: Nothing is still here. If you stop moving, the reflections define you. Keep moving.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The garden is still. The reflections agree — because I am one thing, not many.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The reflections defined me. I stopped moving and they decided who I was. Return with momentum.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: The Mirror Garden is the Kami Gate's identity test. It asks: who are you when every surface shows a different version of you? The Kami answer: you are the one who is looking, not the one being looked at.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: The reflections begin to disagree. Each mirror shows a different version of you. Which is real?

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: More walkers, and they are wearing your face in each mirror. Which one is you?

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: Disagreeing reflections are the Gate's question: who are you when everyone sees you differently? The answer: all of them. And none.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: I am all of my reflections and none of them. The garden could not resolve me. That is victory.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The disagreement broke me. I could not be all of them. I chose one — and the others rebelled.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: Disagreeing reflections are the Gate's way of fragmenting identity. Each mirror shows a different self. The Kami way says all of them are real, but none of them are you.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: The garden shifts. Mirrors become doors. Reflections become rooms. Navigate by truth, not by image.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow image-thieves. They steal reflections, leaving their victims faceless.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: Mirrors as doors lead to reflected rooms — spaces that are real because the mirrors make them real. Navigate by what you know, not what you see.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The image-thieves are repelled. My face is mine. The mirrors can copy it but they cannot take it.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The image-thieves took my reflection. I was faceless in a garden of faces. Recover what was taken.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: Image-thieves are Hollow that survive by stealing faces. A faceless being in the Kami Realm is not invisible — it is nothing. The Kami way considers nothingness worse than death.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: Final mirror. The last reflection shows nothing. It is the true mirror. Face the void.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: The Mirror Gardener — a Gate-entity that tends the reflections like plants, pruning the ones that do not serve.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: The empty mirror shows nothing because it shows truth. Truth is not an image. It is the absence of image. Face it without flinching.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The Mirror Gardener is defeated. It tended lies — beautiful lies, but lies. The empty mirror showed truth, and truth is what I carry.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The empty mirror was too much. Nothing reflected is harder to face than anything. I was not ready.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: The Mirror Gardener tends reflections like a gardener tends plants. Its pruning is the Gate's editing of identity. The empty mirror is its masterpiece: a mirror that shows what you are when every reflection is stripped away. The void. Face it.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: Seven torii stand. An eighth is forming. The eighth torii leads somewhere the Gate has never allowed. Approach.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: Hollow gate-guardians of the seventh torii. They protect the boundary the eighth would break.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: The seventh torii is the last boundary. It exists for a reason. Pass it with respect, not violence — or it will resist.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The eighth torii forms. I walked and it became. The Kami way holds: perception shapes reality.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The eighth torii did not form. I walked but my perception was not strong enough. Believe harder.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: The Eighth Torii is the Kami Gate's ultimate test. Seven torii define the boundaries of the sacred world. The eighth would lead beyond — to what the Gate has never allowed. The test is whether the avatar can walk through what does not exist and make it real by walking.

briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: The False Reflection Kami. Enter False Mirror Sanctum Apex on Torii-Moon Mirror Road through Torii-Moon Gate. Objective: Channeling your avatar of the selected deity, advance through False Mirror Sanctum Apex.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: The eighth torii is incomplete. It needs something to finish. It needs you to walk through it before it exists.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: More guardians, and they have the seventh torii's authority. They are not just guards — they are the wall itself.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: Walk through the eighth before it exists. This is the Kami way: reality follows perception. If you walk, the torii forms around you.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The seventh boundary passed — with respect, not force. The Warden stepped aside because it was asked, not because it was beaten.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The seventh boundary held. I tried to pass with force. The Warden met force with wall. Try with respect.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: The seventh torii resists the eighth because it represents the last known boundary. It is not malicious — it is conservative. It guards the boundary because the boundary has held since the Collapse.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: The seventh torii resists the eighth. It guards the boundary the eighth would cross. Pass the seventh to reach the eighth.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
enemyIntroduction.text: The Seventh Warden — the original guardian of the last allowed boundary. It has never been crossed.

midBattle.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattle.text: The Seventh Warden has never been crossed because no one has tried with respect. It guards because it was asked to. Ask it to step aside.

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The Seventh Warden yields. It was asked and it agreed. The boundary it guarded was not a wall — it was a question. The answer was: yes, with respect.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: The Seventh Warden refused. It was asked — but the asking was not honest. It guards truth. Ask truly.

codex.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
codex.text: The Seventh Warden has never been crossed because every previous attempt used force. Force makes the wall stronger. The Warden was asked to guard, and it was never asked to step aside — until now.
